children: Karbon-X Corp. reported full-year 2026 revenue of $55.86M and a diluted loss per share of ($0.16), versus $3.16M revenue and ($0.08) EPS in the prior year, according to its 10-K filing. The company posted a net loss of ($13.59M) for FY2026.
¹ Reported as “Total revenue”. ² Reported as “Net loss”. ³ Reported as “diluted loss per share”.
Revenue growth was driven by a new trading subsidiary and expanded credit programs, lifting FY2026 sales to $55.9M from $3.16M a year earlier.
The company shifted channels toward high-volume, low-margin industrial carbon credit trading through Karbon-X Trading Limited, which reduced gross margin to 1.5%.
Operational expansion included the June 2025 acquisition of Allcot AG assets and the establishment of additional subsidiaries, broadening the project pipeline and corporate functions.
Karbon-X launched a subscription-based app enabling public purchase of verified offsets supporting diverse clean-energy projects.
Management said available funding is expected to sustain operations into FY2027 if capital is raised, but additional financing will be required to execute its growth plan.
